subject: Coord: Executive presence for Acme architecture deep-dive

Date: 2028-08-01T15:02:00Z
Subject: Proposed times: Exec presence for Acme architecture deep-dive

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused architecture deep-dive for Acme (60 minutes) that includes the technical review plus a short Executive overview so your leadership can sign off on the proposed rollout and SLAs.

Proposed 60-minute options (Pacific):
- Tue Aug 9 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Aug 11 — 09:00–10:00 PT

Goal: have an Acme executive (CIO/CFO/Head of Product) join for the first 15–20 minutes for alignment, then deep-dive with engineering teams. Attendees from Redwood: Aditya (sales), Mina (AE), Vanessa (enterprise lead), Rishi (platform eng).

Attached: draft agenda and a calendar invite stub. Can you confirm which slot works best and who from your exec team will attend? If neither works, please propose two alternatives and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_Redwood_Arch_DeepDive_Agenda.pdf, redwood_arch_deepdive.ics

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear options. I pulled calendars for our execs and neither Aug 9 at 10am PT nor Aug 11 at 9am PT works for our CFO (Sarah) — she's in CFO offsite both days. Two windows that work on our side:

- Wed Aug 10 — 15:00–16:00 PT

If you can move to Thu Aug 11 starting 09:30 PT, that would be ideal — Sarah will be available at 09:30 but has another internal meeting at 10:30. Also: can you share a short attendee list and a one-page outline of the executive portion so Sarah knows what to expect?

I can loop Sarah into the thread if helpful.

Best,
Michael

Acme Corp
